themes.title: Dubai's agentic-AI sprint
themes.summary: The UAE is pushing agentic AI from pilots into production: Sheikh Hamdan reviewed the TACTICA platform for vital sectors, eleven Dubai companies pledged to integrate autonomous agents into their operations, and Dubai launched a global push to turn AI agents into real-world products. Optro set up a UAE hub for agentic-AI governance and Sharjah opened an AI industrial accelerator billed for the 'super-intelligence era'.
themes.angle: GCC's policy-coherent agentic bet is a story the global AI press barely covers.

themes.title: AI's money loop: hyperscaler capex vs 2008 echoes
themes.summary: Capital keeps pouring into AI at scale: Tencent started a $5B bond sale to fund AI spend, SoftBank's reported $100B fund push hints at a late-stage boom, and Bloomberg's Big Take draws parallels between AI's giant money loop and 2008. The FT flags hyperscalers' huge lurking leverage while CFOs tighten budgets as AI costs surge; Microsoft's homegrown chip and Azure reorg show the stack being taken in-house, and Applied Materials says AI lets it double sales without doubling headcount.
themes.angle: 'How much of the AI capex loop is real demand vs leverage?' is the board question for 2027.

themes.title: The Gulf is the new US-China AI battleground
themes.summary: Asia Times argues the US and China are now racing for the Gulf's AI future, and the UAE is walking the talk by sending 16 AI experts to study China's national AI ecosystem. Mubadala circling an Italian telecoms deal underscores how Gulf capital is buying into global AI-adjacent infrastructure.
themes.angle: GCC sovereigns are not picking a side - they are buying both.
